application: SaturnTaisen - Sakura Wars / Sakura Taisen (Sega Saturn)

internal_executables.reason: The recompiled game. Child process started by the primary executable with the player's disc, saves and settings; not a separate app, do not list or launch it directly from a frontend's game grid.
Setup helper started by the primary executable (its Preparar juego section and the --rom flag). Applies the bundled language layers to a copy of the player's discs and builds the HD pack.
Save importer started by the primary executable.

easy_setup.rom: Any one of the player's files, or the folder that holds them. The other files are looked for beside it (same folder, sibling folders, .zip archives).
easy_setup.first_run: Prepares the discs (a few minutes) and, when the PC edition is found, the HD pack; later runs start at once because what is already prepared is recognized and kept.

cli.--rom: path (repeatable; user-supplied, never bundled): a Sakura Taisen Saturn disc as .cue with its tracks, .bin, .img, .iso or .zip (original Japanese GS-9037 V1.005, or already patched with the English translation v2.1), the PC edition (disc image .mdf/.iso, folder with its cabinets, or installed game folder), or a folder with any of them
cli.--no-launcher: skip the launcher UI and start the game with the saved setup (alias: --play)
cli.--setup: open the launcher's setup screen even when the game is ready
cli.--integration-info: print this same launch surface plus the current setup state as machine-readable JSON

helper_cli.preparar-juego.exe scan --folder DIR: print as JSON which of the player's files were recognized in DIR
progress lines start with 'PROGRESO <percent>'; the last line is 'OK {json}' or 'ERROR <message>'; exit code 0 on success
helper_cli.preparar-juego.exe language --language e: switch the language of an already prepared game

user_supplied_files: Sakura Taisen disc 1 for Sega Saturn (Japan, GS-9037 V1.005), original or patched with the English translation v2.1
Sakura Taisen disc 2 for Sega Saturn (Japan, GS-9037 V1.005), original or patched with the English translation v2.1
Optional, for the HD mod: the PC edition (disc image, cabinets folder or installed game folder)
notes: No separate builder step and no extra downloads: every executable ships prebuilt in the release zip. The player's files are only read; the release root holds only SaturnTaisen.exe (the launcher, linked statically), roms/ for the player's files and data/; prepared discs go to data/game/, the HD pack to data/hd-resources/ and settings and saves to data/user/ (portable.txt), all inside the extracted folder, so deleting that folder removes the whole install. Extracting a newer release over the folder keeps data/game/, data/hd-resources/ and data/user/, and nothing is rebuilt unless a language layer or the HD recipe changed. Setting SATURN_TAISEN_FIRST_HOME moves user/ elsewhere. Discs, BIOS and original game files are never bundled.
